title: Animated Input OTP
subtitle: One-time code boxes that fill, shake and confirm.

descriptions.allowedCharacters: Which characters the boxes accept; anything else is ignored as you type or paste.
descriptions.glideRing: One ring that slides from box to box as you type or move with the arrow keys. When off, each box just lights up on its own.
descriptions.charAnimation: How each character appears in its box.
descriptions.pasteStagger: Delay between characters when a whole code is pasted, in seconds. Needs Character in set to anything but None.
descriptions.shakeOnError: Shakes the boxes when the code is wrong or a blocked character is entered.
descriptions.successWave: A wave of the theme's success colour runs across the boxes when the code is right.
descriptions.boxSize: Size of each box, on Tailwind's spacing scale.
descriptions.joined: Joins the boxes into one bar with shared borders.
descriptions.rounded: Corner radius of the boxes. With Joined boxes on, only the outer corners round.
